in_arabic.name: سندر
in_arabic.meaning: المظهر الجذب, الجمال الداخلي والخارجي, الرخاء والمظاهر

in_hindi.name: सुन्दर

in_english.name: Sundar
in_english.long_meaning: The name Sundar is derived from the Arabic root 'sundar', which means beautiful, attractive, charming, lovely, and pleasant. In Islamic tradition, the name Sundar is associated with the qualities of beauty, kindness, and generosity. The name Sundar is also mentioned in the Quran as a description of Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) beautiful character. In modern times, the name Sundar has become popular in many Muslim cultures, symbolizing the beauty and virtues of the Islamic faith.
